matches.title: Demo Store Shipping Policy
matches.text:
Demo Store Shipping Policy
Policy version: 1
Fictional information for a course demonstration.

Delivery coverage
We ship to Riyadh and other cities within Saudi Arabia.
International shipping is not offered.

Shipping cost
Standard shipping costs SAR 25 when the merchandise subtotal after
discounts is below SAR 200.
Standard shipping is free when that subtotal is SAR 200 or more.
The shipping fee does not count toward the free-shipping threshold.

Delivery estimates
Riyadh: 2-4 business days after dispatch.
Other Saudi cities: 3-7 business days after dispatch.
These are estimates, not guaranteed delivery dates.
Business days are Sunday through Thursday, excluding public holidays.

Delivery issues
Report damaged deliveries within 48 hours of receiving the package.
Staff must review damaged, delayed, or missing deliveries.
A report does not automatically approve a refund or replacement.

Tracking
The demonstration assistant cannot access live courier tracking or
verify the status of a specific order.
Customers may include an order reference in a support ticket.

matches.title: Demo Store Returns Policy
matches.text:
Demo Store Returns Policy
Policy version: 1
Fictional information for a course demonstration.

Standard returns
Customers may request a return of a non-personalized item within
14 calendar days of receiving it.
The item must be unused and have its original packaging.
Staff review return requests before approval.

Personalized items
Personalized items are normally excluded from change-of-mind returns.
Defective or damaged personalized items are an exception requiring
staff review. The assistant cannot promise approval.

Damaged deliveries
Report damage discovered on delivery within 48 hours of receipt.
Use Request human support and describe the issue.
Include an order reference if available.

Refunds and cancellations
Only staff can approve or process refunds and cancellations.
An exact refund processing time is not specified.
The assistant cannot issue refunds, cancel orders, verify payments,
or confirm that a refund has completed.

Unspecified information
Return shipping charges and exchange processing times are not specified.
Request human support for these details.

matches.title: Demo Store Support Policy
matches.text:
Demo Store Support Policy
Policy version: 1
Fictional information for a course demonstration.

Routine questions
The assistant answers from documented store information and shows
supporting passages.
If evidence is missing or conflicting, explain the limitation and
offer human support.

Staff review
Damaged deliveries, missing or delayed orders, refunds, replacements,
cancellations, and requests for a human require staff review.
The assistant cannot access live orders or approve these actions.

Creating a ticket
Choose Request human support.
Provide an email address or phone number and describe the issue.
An order reference is optional.
Review the details and explicitly confirm.
A ticket exists only after it is saved and a reference is displayed.
A chat message alone does not create a ticket.

Statuses
Open: saved and awaiting staff handling.
In Progress: staff are working on the request.
Resolved: staff marked the request resolved.
Resolved status alone does not prove a refund was paid or a replacement
was delivered.

Limitations
There is no live agent chat or automatic email notification.
Support opening hours and response-time guarantees are not specified.
Customers can check My tickets in the browser session used to submit them.

Personalized items
Personalized items are normally excluded from change-of-mind returns.
Defective or damaged personalized items are an exception requiring
staff review. The assistant cannot promise approval.

Damaged deliveries
Report damage discovered on delivery within 48 hours of receipt.
Use Request human support and describe the issue.
Include an order reference if available.

Refunds and cancellations
Only staff can approve or process refunds and cancellations.
An exact refund processing time is not specified.

or confirm that a refund has completed.

Demo Store Shipping Policy
Policy version: 1
Fictional information for a course demonstration.

Delivery coverage
We ship to Riyadh and other cities within Saudi Arabia.
International shipping is not offered.

Shipping cost
Standard shipping costs SAR 25 when the merchandise subtotal after
discounts is below SAR 200.
Standard shipping is free when that subtotal is SAR 200 or more.
The shipping fee does not count toward the free-shipping threshold.

Delivery estimates
Riyadh: 2-4 business days after dispatch.
Other Saudi cities: 3-7 business days after dispatch.
These are estimates, not guaranteed delivery dates.
Business days are Sunday through Thursday, excluding public holidays.

Delivery issues
Report damaged deliveries within 48 hours of receiving the package.
Staff must review damaged, delayed, or missing deliveries.
A report does not automatically approve a refund or replacement.

verify the status of a specific order.
